newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY BTP FUTURES START DOWN WITH BUNDS,EYE ON U.S..
newsitem.headline: ITALY BTP FUTURES START DOWN WITH BUNDS,EYE ON U.S..

text.p: 0724 GMT - Italian bonds and futures started lower in line with Bunds following a lower close in T-Bonds. Market very thin with few ideas, anxiously awaiting U.S. data later Wednesday. * Bonds:Jul07 -25bps at 101.50, yield 6.64, Bund spread 95bps * Futures:SepLIF -30 bps at 135.90. Res 136.20, sup 135.55 * Lira:steady vs mark at 977.30/7.60 (FULL BACKGROUND / DETAILS FOLLOW)
